Raboot

Fire

Galar · Generation 8

Raboot is a Fire-type Rabbit Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 9 kg. It evolves from Scorbunny and into Cinderace. Its highest base stat is Speed (94), with a base stat total of 420.
